description: This file defines a report parser class for generating accounting indicator reports in Odoo, including methods for creating graphs, trees, and data arrays, and references external libraries and report templates.

classes.name: accounting_report_indicator
classes.description: A report parser class for generating accounting indicator reports with methods for data processing, graph creation, and tree visualization.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a list of report lines with hierarchy levels and attributes.

methods.name: getarray_head
methods.description: Prepares header data for array representation of report data.

methods.name: getarray
methods.description: Prepares array data for report display, including headers and labels.

methods.name: gettree
methods.description: Creates a tree diagram image representing report hierarchy and saves it as a PNG file.

methods.name: getgraph
methods.description: Generates a bar chart image based on report data and saves it as a PNG file.
